test_confusion_matrix: test the confusion_matrix function to compute a classification confusion matrix from true and predicted labels
test_classification_report: test the classification_report function to generate a formatted text report of precision recall and f1 scores
test_precision_recall_f1_score: test precision recall and f1 score functions for binary and multiclass classification evaluation
test_matthews_corrcoef: test the matthews_corrcoef function to compute the Matthews correlation coefficient for binary and multiclass classification
test_log_loss: test the log_loss function to compute log-loss (cross-entropy) for binary and multiclass probabilistic predictions
